title: Symlinked images are not displayed in the slideshow for desktop background
line: Slideshow folders now show symlinks to images that live inside installed wallpaper packages.
explanation: The image finder skips files inside wallpaper packages (paths containing contents/images/) so package images aren't listed twice. When scanning a folder it applied that check to the symlink's resolved target rather than to the link itself, so a user's link pointing at an image inside a package such as Next or Altai was silently dropped. The check now uses the link's own path; plain files are unaffected since their path and target are the same.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: list symlinks to images inside wallpaper packages

The finder skips images inside wallpaper packages, but it checked where a
symlink points instead of where the link itself is, so links to package
images were missing from the slideshow. Check the link's own path instead.

BUG: 479296

media.caption: Folder ~/slides with three links (into Altai and Next packages, and to a plain copy): only "plain" is listed
Same folder with the fix: all three images are listed and the slideshow shows the linked Altai image

review.text: Fixes the exact root cause in ImageWallpaper::findAll() by applying filterCondition() to the symlink's own path (wp) rather than its resolved target (realwp), so symlinks pointing into wallpaper packages' contents/images/ folders are no longer silently dropped. Plain files are unaffected, package directory recursion is still skipped by the directory check, and screenshot.* files inside packages remain excluded. Before/after screenshots and passing image finder autotests solidly confirm the fix.

reviews.text: Fixes the exact root cause in ImageWallpaper::findAll() by applying filterCondition() to the symlink's own path (wp) rather than its resolved target (realwp), so symlinks pointing into wallpaper packages' contents/images/ folders are no longer silently dropped. Plain files are unaffected, package directory recursion is still skipped by the directory check, and screenshot.* files inside packages remain excluded. Before/after screenshots and passing image finder autotests solidly confirm the fix.

This is the exact cause of the reporter's case: their links point into Next*/contents/images (comments 0 and 10), and findAll() applied the 'inside a package' filter to the link's resolved target instead of the link's own path. The one-line change fixes it without letting the finder descend into package folders, since the directory and top-level checks are unchanged, and plain files behave the same. The screenshot shows all three links listed and in use by the slideshow, and the imagefinder autotests pass. Nit: linked package images are still labelled with the target's name (e.g. 5120x2880) rather than the link's name. That predates this change and doesn't block it.
